csharpDecisions: ResolveValueGenericSpecialization includes explicit value in specialized name/cache key and stores SpecializedValue.
EmitNameExpression substitutes SpecializedValue as RuntimeInt before locals lookup.
EmitArrayRepeat consumes SpecializedValue when CountParameterName matches; no trailing runtime value parameter.
slgDecisions: ordinary_function materializes hidden trailing Int slots when any value generic is used.
emitCompileTimeValueArguments writes numeric source tokens to those runtime arguments.
materializeGenericClosure deduplicates clones by template, result type and actual input types; numeric value arguments are not an independent cache-key component.
requiredBeforeEdit: Confirm CSharp behavior for same concrete input type with different value arguments, direct arithmetic/interpolation/repeat usage and signed values.
Preserve lexical shadowing and nested generic call decisions.
Use one semantic value representation for instance identity, body substitution and caller argument removal; replacing hidden slots alone is insufficient.
